# AFTERLIGHT — Asset credits

## Nitro bottles and tank HUD
Nitro bottle geometry is procedural (LatheGeometry, CylinderGeometry), written in dist/nitro.js. No third-party model is used.
Glow sprite: Kenney Particle Pack, light_01.png (dist/assets/nitro-light.png), CC0 — https://kenney.nl/assets/particle-pack

## Player vehicle
Tesla Roadster 2.0 (Will be enchanced soon), by Michael / gmmichaelonearth.

## Technology

## Default player vehicle — Concept GT
Car Concept, © 2024 Darmstadt Graphics Group GmbH.
Model and textures by Eric Chadwick. CC BY 4.0.
Source: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/CarConcept
License: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/blob/main/Models/CarConcept/LICENSE.md
Based on a CC0 model by Unity Fan. See assets/concept-gt-LICENSE.md for full attribution and trademark exclusions.
Adaptations: corrected authored steering angle, normalized precise ground bounds, reoriented, and animated existing wheel pivots. Concept GT is a fictional in-game name; tuning is for arcade gameplay, not manufacturer specifications.

## Audio
Engine loop (dist/assets/audio/engine-loop.wav): "racing car engine sound loops", loop_0.wav, by domasx2, trimmed and crossfaded (100 ms equal-power tail-to-head crossfade, loop end chosen at a continuous sample) for a seamless wrap. Author states the loops were rebuilt from a public-domain sample and pitch-shifted.
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/racing-car-engine-sound-loops
License: CC0 1.0 — https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Impacts (dist/assets/audio/impact-heavy.mp3, impact-light.mp3): Kenney Impact Sounds, impactMetal_heavy_000 and impactGeneric_light_000 (re-encoded MP3, gain-trimmed to -3 dBFS peak).
Pickup clink (dist/assets/audio/pickup-clink.mp3): Kenney Impact Sounds, impactGlass_light_000 (re-encoded MP3).
Pickup chime (dist/assets/audio/pickup-chime.mp3): Kenney Digital Audio, powerUp2 (re-encoded MP3).
UI click (dist/assets/audio/ui-click.mp3): Kenney Interface Sounds, click_001 (re-encoded MP3).
Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds, https://kenney.nl/assets/digital-audio, https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds
License: CC0 1.0, Kenney (Creative Commons Zero) — https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Tyre squeal, nitro whoosh, wind and sea are synthesised in dist/audio.js (no third-party audio).


Loading screen art (dist/assets/loading-art.jpg, loading-art-960.jpg): rendered from the game's own car model (assets/roadster.glb) and city scene in the game's headless Chrome, then colour-graded. Original work for this project; no third-party artwork.

Engine loop provenance note: OpenGameArt page for the loop (domasx2, CC0) says it was cut from a pdsounds.org sample and later remade from a public-domain sample; the shipped file was additionally crossfaded at the loop point for seamless playback. pickup-clink.mp3 was normalised to -3 dB peak.

## Garage collection additions (October 2026)

BMW E36 M3 by **Martin Trafas (TinoD2)**: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/bmw-e36-m3-762b90efd3dc413cb61c3e3c8097b8ac

Honda NSX 1990 by **Lexyc16**: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/honda-nsx-1990-1cc15628a00a4739a6b6c01128927c8d

Brutalist Interior garage by **vslite**: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/0eb40f2cb2bf4dfdbaae36095825788a

All three: **Creative Commons Attribution 4.0** — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Optimized GLB redistributions: https://github.com/pedrosoandre/carros (geometry simplification/welding/pruning, Meshopt compression). Our runtime adaptations: BMW display plinth removed; vehicle rotation, centering and game scale; NSX wheel pivots recentered without changing geometry; garage staged with fill lights. Original materials retained. Names describe model subjects and do not imply manufacturer endorsement. Detailed primary-source verification and attribution accompany each GLB in assets/.

Meshopt decoder: official Three.js r170 distribution, MIT, bundled at vendor/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js. https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r170

## Stunt ramps
Kenney Racing Kit — ramp.glb by Kenney, Creative Commons CC0 1.0. Official source: https://kenney.nl/assets/racing-kit . License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ . Original GLB copied unchanged from the official archive; runtime centering, scale and placement only. Original license and provenance accompany assets/stunt-ramp.glb.

## Five-car collection and wheel rig update

Porsche 911 (930) Turbo 1975 by Lexyc16: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/porsche-911-930-turbo-1975-de1ffd344c41481892511f7fd332c136

Tesla Roadster 2020 by metarex.4d: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/tesla-roadster-2020-1fbf29e297bd4a17ac39a00a378441d8

Both Creative Commons Attribution 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Optimized licensed redistributions from https://github.com/pedrosoandre/carros (weld, simplification, prune, Meshopt compression). Adaptations: game scale/orientation, rebased authored wheel geometry, body paint choices, and wheel substitutions. The original supplied Roadster remains in the source archive; the active Roadster now uses the authored model above for independent wheels and body paint. No car or wheel model was generated.

GT alloy and Classic mesh options reuse wheel geometry from the credited Khronos Concept GT and Lexyc16 Honda NSX, respectively. Per-source attribution and primary verification records accompany the GLBs. All branding identifies subjects and does not imply endorsement.

## Asphalt surface upgrade
Asphalt 02 by **Rob Tuytel / Poly Haven**, CC0. Official source: https://polyhaven.com/a/asphalt_02 ; license: https://polyhaven.com/license . Original 1K diffuse and OpenGL normal maps, mapped at the source's 3 m surface scale. Files, checksums and provenance accompany the textures in assets/asphalt-source.json and assets/asphalt-LICENSE.md.
